bindings.label: Patient presented with 1-month history of daily epigastric pain and rectal bleeding
49-year-old man with past medical history of acquired immune deficiency syndrome (last CD4 count of 10 cells/mm³)
Physical exam revealed condyloma acuminata in the perianal region
Colonoscopy reveals a 6 cm ulcerated polypoid rectal mass
Biopsy of the rectal mass shows mixed spindle and epithelioid cells
Rectal mass is Kaposi sarcoma (AIDS-associated GI malignancy)
CT shows nonspecific colitis pattern, not excluding malignancy
